papers.title_en: From Winding-Fault Geometry to Reliability: Estimation and Prognosis of Stator Inter-Turn Faults
papers.authors: Bambang L. Widjiantoro, Syahrul Munir, Katherin Indriawati, Moh Kamalul Wafi
papers.evidence: 感应电机定子匝间故障估计与预测
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对感应电机定子匝间短路故障的集成框架，通过几何故障模型刻画故障严重程度与空间分布。利用增强状态粒子滤波器实现故障状态与严重程度的联合估计，并结合四种预后模型进行剩余寿命预测与可靠性评估。该研究实现了从物理建模到在线诊断、退化预测及可靠性分析的统一，为电机健康管理提供了精确的确定性与概率性评估手段。
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops an integrated framework for estimation, prognosis, and reliability assessment of stator inter-turn faults in induction motors. The fault is characterized by its severity, defined as the fraction of short-circuited turns, and its spatial orientation. A geometric fault model shows that the resulting output signature is affine in the fault severity and exhibits a fundamental spatial periodicity. Exploiting this structure, an augmented-state particle filter jointly estimates the nonlinear electromechanical state and the unknown fault severity while quantifying posterior uncertainty. The estimated degradation is then propagated using four prognostic models: linear trend, Holt exponential smoothing, Bayesian degradation, and particle-based forecasting. Their predictions are connected to threshold-crossing remaining useful life (RUL), first-passage reliability, degradation-dependent hazard reliability, and a Weibull lifetime benchmark, thereby providing both deterministic and probabilistic health assessments. Numerical results demonstrate accurate online fault estimation and output reconstruction, characterize the effects of degradation pattern and prediction horizon on prognosis, and show consistent reliability and threshold-crossing predictions. Moreover, estimation accuracy remains comparable across the distinct fault orientations induced by the spatial periodicity. The resulting framework provides a unified connection from physics-based inter-turn fault modeling to online diagnosis, degradation prognosis, and reliability assessment.

papers.title_en: A Machine Learning Framework for Fault Detection, Isolation, and Severity Prediction of Autonomous VTOL Aircraft
papers.authors: Ripon C. Sarker, Pedram H. Dabaghian, Raman Goyal, Atanu Halder
papers.evidence: 多旋翼飞行器转子损伤的故障检测与隔离
papers.tldr: 本文针对自主VTOL飞行器在复杂环境下易受转子故障影响的问题，提出了一种基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的故障检测、隔离与严重程度预测框架。该方法通过学习多变量飞行动态的时空特征，实现了对转子故障的精准识别与损伤程度量化。研究通过仿真与六旋翼无人机实飞实验验证，证明了该框架在实时健康监测中的高准确性与强泛化能力，为提升飞行器安全性提供了有效技术支撑。
papers.abstract_en: Fault detection in autonomous VTOL aircraft is critical because even minor component degradations can rapidly destabilize multirotor vehicles operating in complex, safety-critical environments, motivating robust fault detection and estimation strategies capable of identifying early signs of rotor damage; however, real-flight fault detection remains challenging due to sensor noise, environmental disturbances, and the nonlinear aerodynamics of multirotor platforms. This study proposes a comprehensive machine-learning framework for rotor fault detection, isolation, and severity prediction using real flight data. A convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture is developed to learn spatio-temporal patterns from multivariate flight dynamics, enabling direct inference of both the faulted rotor and its damage level. The framework is first validated using simulated data generated by a data-generative model, and experimental validation is then performed on a hexacopter by introducing controlled blade-tip breakage. The trained model achieves rotor-wise fault classification accuracies above 99% and severity estimation accuracy of 96% within a 1% tolerance in experimental data, demonstrating strong generalization and supporting real-time health monitoring for autonomous VTOL systems.

papers.title_en: Formal Synthesis of Robust Koopman-Model Predictive Control: A Case Study in AC-DC Power Conversion
papers.authors: Shun Hirose, Shiu Mochiyama, Yoshihiko Susuki
papers.evidence: 交流-直流功率变换的鲁棒模型预测控制
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种鲁棒Koopman模型预测控制（RK-MPC）方法，旨在解决非线性动力系统的形式化综合问题。该方法通过将信号时序逻辑（STL）规范集成到优化问题中，实现了数据驱动的控制策略，并从理论上证明了闭环系统的性能。研究通过在AC-DC功率转换器设计中的应用，验证了该方法在处理复杂非线性动态时的鲁棒性与有效性。
papers.abstract_en: This letter proposes a formal synthesis of Robust Koopman-Model Predictive Control (RK-MPC), a novel data-driven approach to formal synthesis of systems with nonlinear dynamics. We formulate a novel optimization problem for RK-MPC by incorporating specifications described by Signal Temporal Logic and prove its closed-loop performance. Effectiveness of the proposed RK-MPC is evaluated by applying it to the reliable design of an AC-DC power converter.
